summary: Alto Neuroscience filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a follow-on public offering of 3,776,436 shares of common stock at $26.48 per share, raising ~$100M gross. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing shelf registration statement. Joint book-running managers are BofA Securities, Stifel, William Blair, and Baird. There is no special-situation catalyst such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction to raise proceeds for general corporate purposes, not a special situation.
